snapshot.title: Tidy-ups: docs, schemas, tests
snapshot.description:
- Stale package docs: `internal/daemon/doc.go` (auto-start) and `internal/mcp/doc.go` (resource subscriptions) describe features that don't exist yet; update as they land.
- MCP schema noise: the `item` description includes Item's storage-path comment; real oneofs' own comments aren't included; `/* */` comments keep their ` * ` prefixes.
- Duplicated feature/task `depends_on` switches (core/graph.go, service/deps.go).
- Test gaps: project `include_children`, skipped bad history files, reconciliation of a task with no ChangeEvent, MCP `permission_denied`, Connect user-only RPCs, Warn logging of bad item files.
